description: Search Reddit posts by keyword, optionally in one subreddit: 25 posts with title, text, subreddit, score, comments, date and link. Usernames are removed. Use it when: You want honest user opinions, recommendations or complaints on a topic. Not for: Fast lookups; this is one of the slower nodes, taking 20 to 65 seconds per call. Returns: 25 posts: title, text, subreddit, score, comment count, date, link and flair. No usernames. Typical time: about 40 s. Price: $0.039 per search (up to 25 posts), charged only on success. One call = up to 25 posts.

period.description: How far back to look; default year

query.description: What to search for, e.g. best budget mechanical keyboard

subreddit.description: Optional subreddit name without r/, e.g. MechanicalKeyboards
